## Is your feature request related to a problem?

A clear, concise description of what the problem is
(e.g. "I'm always frustrated when...").

## Describe the solution you'd like

What you want to happen, and which module it affects (Home, Time Management,
Claude Runners, Claude Code, etc.).

## Describe alternatives you've considered

Any alternative solutions or features you've thought about.

## Additional context

Mockups, examples from other apps, or anything else relevant.
